Slice 2 of the beadrs-40f0cc4e split verified complete. The fix itself landed in 05d4bf32 (prior attempt; already on origin/main). This attempt completed the neutral-ground verification the earlier attempts could not finish; it made no file changes, so there is nothing new to commit or push (git rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty).

Root cause (recorded in the notes by the fixing attempt; classification confirmed by this attempt): out-of-band DELETE FROM issues cascades to events (ON DELETE CASCADE, FK enforced), dropping MAX(sequence) below the pointer's snapshot_sequence; classify()'s recorded-generation fast path required covered <= live, so the workspace's own publication was misread as remote-advanced, and verify_superset's positional wire-identity re-derivation renumbered post-gap survivors into the covered-ahead integrity refusal. The two recorded leads (wire-identity derivation, parse normalization) were each sound mechanisms; the defect was the covered<=live guard on the fast path plus dirty := covered < live hiding the republish.

Verification layout: git-archive extraction of HEAD 08ec9a1a retained at /home/coding/.needle/state/gates/beadrs-f2be307c-20261025-081500/extraction; private target /data/build/bead-rs/gate-f2be307c (subdir of the enforced root, hardlink-seeded warm, workspace artifacts purged); fresh TMPDIR /data/bead-dod-f2be307c/t1 with ancestor chain probed free of .beads.

No open bead owns it; it belongs to beadrs-4c81a20f's explicitly deferred reconcile/fork-across-the-migration-boundary scope. Not slice-2 scope; recorded here for that family and for slice 4's combined run (beadrs-b3410476), which will meet it.

Slice 3 of beadrs-40f0cc4e: set-v2-crash-ordering is green. The fix landed on main as e71aaa4b (seal the outgoing tail whole, from the pointer's segmentation) after slice 2's superset-refusal fix (beadrs-f2be307c, 05d4bf32); the two prior dispatches on this bead landed the work but died before verification/closure. This dispatch re-verified the landed HEAD end to end rather than re-implementing.

Residual root cause beyond the slice-2 refusal (recorded per acceptance; same analysis as e71aaa4b's message): two layers. (1) Writer: pack_event_segments repacked the whole canonical event stream from scratch on every publication, so a tail crossing SEG_SEAL split at the greedy boundary instead of sealing the outgoing tail whole (spec 6.2 rename; 7.4 step 4 removal). (2) Test calibration: the seal driver's budget was sized for shard bytes (2.2 KiB fillers) while update events are ~330-byte markers, so 40 rounds accumulate ~13 KiB against the 64 KiB SEG_SEAL and the scenario could never reach a seal. Fixed by previous_segmentation() carrying sealed rows forward from pointer+manifest (end-identity check, from-scratch fallback on out-of-band deletion), sealing the outgoing tail whole, and a 240-round driver that captures the outgoing tail sha per round. The generation_id assert_ne from 5f18473c is retained.

No further residual gap found: the scenario now passes against the section 7.4 publication procedure and crash-safe ordering assertions, and all seven sibling scenarios plus the out-of-band re-verification grid stay green in the same scoped run.

Out of scope (unchanged): reader/migration/restore, redaction tooling (beadrs-4c81a20f), retention/tombstone behavior beyond the scenario's assertions.
